## Positioning

Siya Pawar is a Gen-Z lifestyle influencer and Instagram Reels creator based in Pune. She produces high-retention short-form video, aesthetic product photography, and brand UGC for D2C and lifestyle brands across India — creator-direct, with transparent rates and no agency markup.
